text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, July 24, 2019, Appeal DDRT2020-01

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog and exempted the applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued July 24, 2019, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Annie Rosen and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before January 29, 2020.
